profile_text.body:
Runway, founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, describes itself as building foundational Real-World Intelligence that can understand, simulate and act in the world. The company offers products and services built on this intelligence to empower individuals and organizations, with a focus on media production and generative capabilities. According to its website, every component is powered by GWM-1, Runway's state-of-the-art General World Model designed to interact with the real world. The company has announced a planned $100M investment in the UK AI ecosystem and opened a London headquarters as a European research hub.

Runway's primary tracked product is its video generation and editing platform, also named Runway. The company has introduced the Runway Media Router, described as the first preference-optimized router for generative media built into the Runway Dev platform. The company publishes research on enterprise adoption, including findings from hundreds of enterprises on cost and speed gains in media production.

The company faces litigation in multiple jurisdictions. Cases include David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. in both the District Court for the Southern District of New York and the District Court for the Central District of California, Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc. in the Southern District of New York, and Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc. also in the Southern District of New York. The held facts indicate 327 cases with New York law exposure.
